To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Ras-GAP GefE regulates Ras-GTPase activation to set the threshold for cell type proportioning in Dictyostelia.

(i) Ras-GTPase signaling sets the intrinsic response thresholds to differentiation inducing signals, (ii) Ras-GTPases are activated by heterogeneous and dynamic transcriptional activation of their activators, (iii) Ras-GTP signaling is necessary to maintain this transcriptional heterogeneity, and (iv) the resulting heterogeneous Ras-GTP signaling leads to salt and pepper differentiation and sorting out, which is required for position-independent patterning.
the RasGTPase activator GefE is required for lineage priming and that RasGTPase activity sets an intrinsic response threshold to differentiation signals.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how cells become different from one another.
the development of new and more effective therapies to treat cancer.
the molecular mechanisms that underlie cell fate specification and differentiation in multicellular organisms.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

RasGTPase activity is required to set the intrinsic response threshold of cells to differentiation inducing signals, and that RasGTP is required for lineage priming and position independent salt and pepper differentiation.
Ras-GTPase activation is required for lineage priming and heterogeneity generation.

Ras-GTPase activation is necessary to generate heterogeneity in Ras-GTPase signaling and that this heterogeneity is necessary to generate the heterogeneity in cell behavior that is observed in Dictyostelum.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Ras GTPase regulator GefE is necessary for normal cell type proportioning in Dictyosteliun.
we have shown that the Ras pathway regulates the intrinsic response threshold in Dictyosteliam.
we have identified a novel mechanism for generating heterogeneity in the cell population that is required for salt and pepper patterning.
The main takeaway from our work is that
heterogeneity can emerge from a uniform cell population by a combination of intrinsic and extrinsic factors.

Ras-GTPase signaling is required for normal cell type proportioning during Dictyostelium development, and that Ras-GTPases are required for both the intrinsic response to differentiation signals as well as the heterogeneous expression of differentiation regulators.
the molecular basis of heterogeneity is not as simple as a stochastic process.
